title: Full-network representation checkpoint corrected greedy-bridge fresh5k
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The exact full-network representation checkpoint was externally tested only under strict sampled execution, where Standard10 itself loses about 37.55 bb/100 versus historical greedy. Because the checkpoint replicated large internal breadth gains in two untouched cohorts, evaluating the identical SHA under the now-audited physical-v6 legacy-observation greedy contract may reveal whether its prior -81.251 bb/100 primarily reflected execution mismatch rather than absent learned strength.
material_change: Freeze SHA ff2b9e6fe188ac89aa3ff4b632b70a195a46e8e6a73f1b94a75fcfbbf543c17e unchanged. Run eight wholly new independent 625-hand journaled Slumbot sessions with policy-mode greedy, legacy-v4 observation bridge, current frozen physical-v6 runtime, seeds 2026264001..2026264008, no retry or score-based replacement. Use raw hand JSONL for bb/100 and CI plus replay/token/session-independence audits. Admit only a separate fresh20k if fresh5k bb/100 > -40 and raw CI upper > 0.
baseline: Same SHA strict sampled fresh20k was -81.2510 bb/100, CI [-123.1600,-39.3420], under a runtime later shown to have five native rule/action discrepancies. Historical Standard10 greedy is -11.4275 versus strict sampled -48.9778. Retained integrated Seed1 1M corrected greedy fresh20k is -21.7592.
source: matched-weak-kl-representation-curve-20260830 full checkpoint and representation-scope-independent-confirmation-20260831; current audited v6 journaled runtime.
notes: This is an execution-contract adjudication of an old frozen learned checkpoint, not checkpoint reselection and not evidence that sampled execution was invalid. Old sampled hands remain separate and will never be pooled with this fresh greedy cohort. A negative 5k stops this SHA only; it does not reject full-network representation learning at larger scale.

Shared CI tool used active Standard10 baseline -11.4275 and correctly reports no formal milestone. Independence audit found eight unique session IDs, policy seeds, token chains, and visible-deal sequences with zero same-position matches. No old sampled hands were pooled.

result.summary: The exact unchanged full-network representation SHA completed eight independent fresh625 corrected physical-v6 legacy-observation greedy sessions. All 5,000 raw hands, 8/8 child exits, action replay, terminal checks, token chains, checkpoint/runtime identities, and session-independence gates passed. Raw result was -68.8218 bb/100, CI [-147.2755,+9.6319], with 2/8 positive sessions.
result.conclusion: Correcting execution to the historical greedy contract does not rescue this old full-network checkpoint. Its point estimate improves only 12.43 bb/100 versus its separate strict-sampled -81.251 result and remains 57.39 bb/100 below historical Standard10 greedy. Because it misses the preregistered -40 floor, this exact SHA is not admitted to fresh20k. The result rejects this checkpoint transfer, not representation learning in general: its training/internal evidence used a pre-repair rules contract and cannot justify further external spend.
result.next_step: Do not extend or retrain from this pre-repair full-network checkpoint. Retain Standard10 and the corrected-contract integrated 1M parent as references. The next training route must learn under corrected physical-v6 semantics and show geometric multi-seed broad slopes plus external-direction alignment before million-scale allocation; avoid more local teacher/objective additions already contradicted by fresh evidence.
